core_obligations: In the section situation (S, X, T, U, X' over X with f, T', U'), if f is locally of finite type then f_{/T'} : X'_{/T'} to X_{/T} is locally of finite type.
The proof takes a scheme Z to X with image in T, identifies Z x_{X_{/T}} X'_{/T'} with Z x_X X' via the cartesian square, and applies base change of local finite type.
proof_roadmap: Let Z to X be a scheme morphism with |Z| in T; by the cartesian square Z x_{X_{/T}} X'_{/T'} = Z x_X X'.
Z x_X X' to Z is locally of finite type by base change, hence f_{/T'} is locally of finite type.
